answer: What survives to the nectar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. A beacon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lotus of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short.
